• System: Electronics

  • Device: Battery

  • Fault: Warning "Remote Software Upgrade: Battery charge very low. Unable to start installation."

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Vehicle battery charge status too low to perform Remote Software Upgrade

• Action: Charge the vehicle battery, perform the Remote Software Upgrade during the charging operation and ensure that the charger remains connected throughout the entire Remote Software Upgrade process

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: CAUTION : Using a diagnostic tool, verify that all related systems are functioning properly. If there are any DTCs or symptomatic conditions other than those listed, resolve them before proceeding with this bulletin.
